headline: Sensex and Nifty Extend Rally for Fifth Straight Day as Asian Markets Rise and Oil Prices Crash

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Sensex and Nifty extended their winning streak, rising 5.5% over five consecutive trading sessions.
Crude oil prices crashed 16% this week with Brent crude falling below $95, unwinding war premium.
Asian stocks gained as global markets digested the impact of the US midterm election results.
Sensex reclaimed its 200-day moving average (200-DMA), signaling sustained bullish market momentum.
whatHappening: Nifty crossed above 23,900 while Sensex added 384 points in the latest session gains.
Dividend record date today for Amara Raja, CARE Ratings, Happiest Minds, NALCO, and Amrutanjan.
Alembic Pharma reported Q2 earnings while Sitaram Denims filed draft papers for an IPO.
Alcohol stocks jumped following global market reactions to US election shifts.
summary: Indian benchmark indices Sensex and Nifty extend gains for the fifth consecutive day with Nifty crossing 23,900. Global market cues remain favorable as Asian equities rise following the US midterm elections and Brent crude prices drop 16% this week. Multiple stock-specific developments including dividend record dates and earnings results are driving action in domestic trade today.
